name: MegaHack CPS Bridge
description: Mirrors gameplay held-input state into MegaHack's CPS presentation so bot playback is not colourless.

enabled.name: Enable CPS Bridge
enabled.description: Mirror gameplay press/release state into MegaHack's CPS counter presentation.

all-buttons.name: All Gameplay Buttons
all-buttons.description: Also mirror platformer Left/Right inputs. Off = Jump only, matching the normal CPS use-case.

fallback-cps-scan.name: Fallback CPS Text Scan
fallback-cps-scan.description: If MegaHack node IDs cannot be identified, allow a limited search for visible labels containing CPS.

debug-log.name: Debug Log
debug-log.description: Log observed gameplay press/release events and CPS-label discovery.
